Doctorate
The KIT Department of Chemical and Process Engineering offers a variety of opportunities to do a doctorate in exciting and current subject areas. If you are interested, please contact the institute of your choice directly and pay attention to the job advertisements of KIT.
Promotionsarbeiten
Submission of Documents
Please make an appointment to submit documents in person.
Please use the following address when sending your documents via mail and please contact us before sending:
Karlsruher Institut für Technologie
KIT-Fakultät für Chemieingenieurwesen und Verfahrenstechnik
Kaiserstraße 12
76131 Karlsruhe

Doctoral Theses at the KIT Department since 1970
A complete list of all dissertations published at the KIT Department of Chemical and Process Engineering since 1970 can be found here: Doctorates 1970 - 2025.
On request, you can have a look at the dissertations in the Dean's Office of the KIT department.
